daily.title: JENNIE RELEASES NEW ALBUM TITLED "FALLEN ANGEL"
daily.description: After a long wait Blackpink's Jennie released a new EP " FALLEN ANGEL". This EP includes three new songs that are available on all digital platforms! Physical album release date is the 30th of October 2026.

daily.title: TXT ANNOUNCES WORLD TOUR 2026-2027
daily.description: TXT announces their fifth world tour named " STEAL THE WIND". This tour will kick off in Korea this year on November 13 2026! Keep in mind that NEW dates will be released soon!
